profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Platforms | LLMs & Agentic AI | GCP Certified | Founding Cloud Engineer scaling 0→2.7 PB
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer | Founding Cloud Engineer | Distributed Systems & Applied AI

Staff Software Engineer and founding cloud engineer specializing in large-scale, event-driven distributed systems and, more recently, LLM and agentic AI tooling. I take high-level concepts and turn them into production-ready systems, owning them end to end.

At RADAR (YC-backed; Series A→B; recognized in The Information’s 50 Most Promising Startups 2023), I built the cloud platform from the ground up. Today, it processes 10B+ events per day (~180K msgs/sec) and manages ~2.7 PB in BigQuery across 9 enterprise tenants and ~1,800 stores, supporting retailers including Gap, American Eagle, Old Navy, and Macy’s.

What I work on:
- Event-driven architecture at scale: Designed a multi-tenant system with 2,000+ Pub/Sub topics, 3,900+ subscriptions, and Kafka streams to fully decouple producers and consumers.
- High-performance backend services: Operate the Cumulus REST API (200+ endpoints, 45M+ transactions/week) with p99 latency around 360 ms, optimized across BigQuery and PostgreSQL.
- Platform engineering and reliability: Led zero-downtime migration from Docker Swarm to Kubernetes, implemented OpenZiti for zero-trust access, and manage infrastructure via Terraform; primary on-call with full observability (Prometheus, New Relic).
- Applied AI: As AI Committee Lead, drive company-wide adoption of LLMs and agentic AI (Claude Code, Gemini, Codex) across code review, testing, and development. Creator of meihua-yishu (160+ GitHub stars).

Before RADAR:
12 years building Java/Spring distributed systems, including the industry’s first WLAN controller supporting 30K access points and 300K concurrent clients (GSMA “Best Mobile Broadband Technology,” 2011).

Tech Stack:
Go, Python, Java · GCP (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, GKE, Vertex AI, Composer) · PostgreSQL · Kafka · Terraform · Kubernetes · LLMs / Agentic AI

Certifications:
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect · Professional ML Engineer · Professional Data Engineer · Professional Database Engineer
Based in Elk Grove, CA · Open to remote opportunities
Open to Staff Software Engineer roles in distributed systems, backend platforms, and applied AI.

#DistributedSystems #BackendEngineering #GoogleCloud #Kubernetes #LLM #AgenticAI

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding Cloud Engineer & AI Committee Lead | RADAR (YC-backed, Series A→B)

Recognized in The Information’s 50 Most Promising Startups (2023)
Built and scaled RADAR’s cloud platform from the ground up into a high-throughput, event-driven data system supporting enterprise retail at scale. Currently processes ~10B+ events/day (~180K msgs/sec) and manages ~2.7 PB of data in BigQuery across 9 enterprise tenants and ~1,800 stores.

Key Contributions:
- Architected a multi-tenant, event-driven platform with 2,000+ Pub/Sub topics, 3,900+ subscriptions, and Kafka streams, enabling full decoupling of producers and consumers.
- Operate and scale the Cumulus REST API (200+ endpoints, 45M+ transactions/week) with p99 latency ≈ 360 ms.
- Optimized BigQuery and PostgreSQL performance and cost across a 2.7 PB data warehouse.
Built secure shared services, including a product catalog pipeline integrating 7 retailers with universal SKU support, EAN deduplication, and multi-language capabilities.
- Led zero-downtime migration from Docker Swarm to Kubernetes and implemented zero-trust access via OpenZiti with Terraform-managed infrastructure.
- Identified and resolved a long-standing (2-year) Cloud NAT port exhaustion issue at root cause.
Owned platform reliability end-to-end: primary on-call, resolved production incidents permanently, and implemented observability (Prometheus, New Relic).
- Authored 50+ design docs, RFCs, migration plans, and RCAs; scaled and mentored the cloud engineering team from 1 to 20+ engineers.

AI Leadership:
- Lead AI Committee driving adoption of LLMs and agentic AI across engineering workflows (code review, testing, development).
- Evaluated and implemented tools including Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and OpenAI Codex.
Creator of meihua-yishu (open-source LLM tool, 160+ GitHub stars).

Tech Stack:
Go, Python, Java · GCP (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, GKE, Composer/Airflow, Vertex AI) · PostgreSQL · Kafka · Redis · Terraform · Kubernetes · LLMs / Agentic AI

positions.title: Principal Cloud Engineer
positions.description: Built and scaled the industry's first WLAN controller for 30,000 access points and 300,000 concurrent clients in Java / Spring Boot / Reactive Spring — winner of the GSMA "Best Mobile Broadband Technology" award (2011). Designed the first combined access-point + switch controller on the market, and led the migration of all customers from VM-based systems to Kubernetes. Progressed from Software Engineer to Manager to Architect, then returned to a hands-on Staff IC role by choice.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect

projects.title: ProofMi - Tamper-Proof Photo Verification App
projects.description: A 0-to-1 product I designed and shipped end-to-end, live on iOS and Android. Live-captured photos are cryptographically signed at capture and co-signed by the guest, so move-in/out evidence is tamper-proof and AI-fake-proof. Built the mobile app, backend, and go-to-market.
